verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Goa overlooks the waters of Bambolim Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Goa overlooks the visually stunning waters of the Bambolim Bay

verified_facts.text: The resort spreads across 28 acres of tropical gardens and lawns that roll down to the water's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel in Goa spreads across 28 acres of colourful, tropical gardens and lush lawns that roll down to the water’s edge.

verified_facts.text: Every room has a balcony with views of sunsets, the free-form swimming pool or tropical gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room at Grand Hyatt Goa features a balcony offering relaxed seating with views of magical sunsets, free-form swimming pool or tropical gardens.

verified_facts.text: Suites feature a whirlpool on the suite balcony overlooking gardens and ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 16 suites also feature a whirlpool in the suite balcony overlooking gardens and ocean.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a marble bathroom with a tub and a separate walk-in rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a tub and separate walk-in rain shower in the spacious marble bathroom

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms with bay views, an outdoor tub overlooking Bambolim Bay, a private kitchen and a personal butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suite also features an opulent marble bathroom with a walk-in shower and an outdoor tub overlooking Bambolim Bay. Additional highlights include a private kitchen, an in-room bar, a personal butler and a guest bathroom.

verified_facts.text: Club Access rooms include the Grand Club lounge, with a limited breakfast, all-day coffee and tea, and evening drinks and canapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: access to the Grand Club lounge, which serves a limited breakfast, all-day coffee and tea, evening drinks and canapes

verified_facts.text: Shamana Spa combines modern therapies with ancient Indian traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enter a serene retreat at Shamana Spa, where modern therapies blend with ancient Indian traditions at Grand Hyatt Goa.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool area has a leisure pool and a kids' pool facing Bambolim Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: our outdoor pool area, featuring a leisure pool and a kids' pool facing Bambolim Bay

verified_facts.text: There is also an indoor lap pool, with separate steam and sauna facilities next to whirlpools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Keep up with your fitness routine in our 25-metre indoor lap pool, then relax in separate steam and sauna facilities adjacent to our whirlpools.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a collection of more than 101 experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: choose from a collection of more than 101 experiences offered at our resort

verified_facts.text: An adventure park offers a zip line, sky cycle, wall climbing and a rope course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Get an adrenaline rush with our adventure package that includes our zip line, sky cycle, wall climbing, rope course and more

verified_facts.text: The resort has a casino, Casino Strike by Big Daddy, offering a variety of international games.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casino Strike by Big Daddy offers a world-class gaming experience through a variety of international games

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room is an all-day restaurant with five live kitchens, with Asian, Indian and Italian choices among others.
verified_facts.excerpt: This all-day-dining restaurant features five live kitchens, that embrace the idea of eating out of the pan, off the grill and out of the wok. Guests can enjoy a myriad of choices that include a taste of Asian, Indian, Italian

verified_facts.text: Pool Bar and Grill sits steps from the bay, by the free-form outdoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just steps away from the bay, Pool Bar and Grill at Grand Hyatt Goa is designed to be the perfect place for refreshments, lunch or dinner while soaking in the free form outdoor pool.

verified_facts.text: Architecture features soaring doors and windows, tiled roofs and recessed balconies with reflecting pools, a ruined chapel and ancient banyans.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grandly austere style with soaring doors, windows, and tiled roofs and cool, recessed balconies enhanced by reflecting pools, a picturesquely ruined chapel, and the convoluted contours of ancient banyans.

verified_facts.text: Dabolim Airport (GOI) is 25 kilometers away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dabolim Airport (GOI)25 kilometers25 kilometers

verified_facts.text: Valet parking and self-parking are complimentary for resort guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Goa offers complimentary on-site parking facilities and valet services for resort guests.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is inside Shamana Spa and offers certified trainers, TRX Suspension Training and a customisable fitness bootcamp.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take your fitness to another level at our fitness centre, located within our Shamana Spa. With certified fitness trainers, fitness activities, TRX Suspension Training, resistance bands and a customisable fitness bootcamp

verified_facts.text: The spa is 34,000 square feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 34,000-square-foot spa, and indoor and outdoor pools
